# PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Fredericia)

PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Fredericia) is a clinical unit reported in Denmark's 2024 ADHD database, which tracks quality indicators for ADHD treatment across the country's psychiatric services. The unit appears in the database's rollout of two specific indicators measuring how well treatment centers meet care benchmarks for adult ADHD patients.

On Indicator 10 — which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's social support needs were assessed within 120 days of starting treatment — PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Fredericia) recorded a completion rate of just 16 percent (with a confidence interval of 8–27 percent), based on 10 out of 63 eligible cases [^src1]. This result falls far short of the national quality target of 90 percent, and is also notably below the national average of 37 percent reported for this indicator in 2024, the first year it was measured [^src1]. Regional averages for Indicator 10 ranged between 14 and 52 percent, underscoring that the unit's shortfall was part of a broader pattern of low compliance nationwide, which the steering group behind the ADHD database attributed partly to registration practices and data quality from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals [^src1].

By contrast, on Indicator 11 — which tracks the proportion of adult patients who are in ADHD medication treatment within 120 days of starting a structured treatment pathway ("pakkeforløb") — PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Fredericia) performed considerably better, achieving 71 percent (confidence interval 59–82 percent), based on 45 out of 63 cases [^src2]. This indicator, also newly introduced in 2024 following the expansion of the ADHD database to include adult patients, showed wide regional variation nationally, from 85 percent in Region Nordjylland to 37 percent in Region Hovedstaden — a spread the database's authors suggest likely reflects differences in registration practice rather than genuine differences in clinical care [^src2].

Taken together, the two data points paint a mixed picture: PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Fredericia) struggled significantly with early assessment of patients' social support needs, but performed reasonably well in ensuring patients began ADHD medication in a timely manner.
